newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures finish higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures finish higher.

text.p: Sept 12 - U.S. stock index futures finished higher with Dec S&P 500 futures at a 10-week high after benign inflation data earlier today. Treasury bond and blue chip strength formed a platform for S&Ps to remain firm all session. Trader noted attempts to pull back were underpinned and S&Ps "closed on a pretty strong note." Market awaits CPI on Friday. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
